Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The combined change affects contour toolpaths and can change posted G-code.

What passed:

- The trial merge with upstream main `7b4dc0d8995d79a0b783271d4e99c08f32f27e2a` has no conflicts.
- All 10 moved or retained function bodies are byte-identical to stack base `ceac40dd9`. The split preserves the public entry paths.
- The structural checks fail for the old 514-line and 473-line files. They pass for the split files at 396 and 132 lines.
- No UI files changed. UI screenshots are not required.
- No golden files changed against upstream main or the stack base. There are no moved golden lines to check.

Local build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Selected motion and app test builds | Passed |
| Motion library | 434 passed, 10 ignored |
| App library | 367 passed, 1 ignored |
| `contour_whole` | 7 passed |
| `contour_whole_step` | 3 passed |
| `real_tip_contour` | 4 passed |
| Quick gate | 193 steps: 191 passed, 2 failed; 2,310 tests passed, 2 failed, 68 ignored |
| Clippy, both touched crates, all targets, warnings denied | Passed |

The two gate failures are:

- `thread_boss::an_external_m8_thread_verifies_clean_and_posts_helical_moves`
- `thread_mill::a_multi_form_mill_threads_m8_clean_and_posts_helical_moves`

Both fail at `crates/app/tests/common/mod.rs:252`:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed
```

The stale NC goldens are `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` and `thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`. I checked each changed line. Only tool comments, T numbers, and H numbers differ. I ran both exact tests on a separate source copy of upstream main `7b4dc0d8995d79a0b783271d4e99c08f32f27e2a`. Both fail there too. Their generated NC and expected NC are identical to this trial merge. These are pre-existing main failures. The full quick gate is red.

I repeated two safety mutations in an isolated source copy under the worktree's ignored `target/` directory:

| Mutation | Result with mutation | Result after restore |
|---|---|---|
| Remove `check_unread` | The vertical-sliver diagnostic test failed | Passed |
| Pass `&lad` instead of `&trimmed` to `emit_band` | The two-island test failed: 194.130 mm instead of one lap of about 97 mm | Passed |

After restoration, all 7 original contour tests passed.

Requested before merge:

1. **Keep the middle outline when no flat cut level falls on it.** See `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:270` and `:301`. The next slice is taken at the next flat cut level. This can skip a complete intermediate step and still return `Ok`.

   I ran `middle_step_without_a_flat_level_gets_its_floor_pass`, from the later fix on parent PR #2460, against this PR's trial-merged source copy. The fixture has a base at Z0..10, a middle step at Z10..20, and a boss at Z20..30. Top Z is 30, Bottom Z is 0, and stepdown is 25. The flat levels are Z5 and Z0. After the boss floor pass, the next slice selects the base outline and skips the middle step. The test fails:

   ```text
   expected one lap around the middle step at Z 10, got 0.000
   ```

   Include the parent's middle-band fix and its regression test before this PR merges. Cut the intermediate floor pass, or report the uncut Z range. Do not return a complete path with that wall silently left uncut.

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2537`. No GitHub runner was used. The PR source remains unchanged. No test, image, log, or review evidence was committed or pushed. The batch and release gates were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This update fixes the requested change on head `23e1a0ed1`.

### 1. Keep the middle outline when no flat cut level falls on it

- **What changed:** We merged `upstream/main` (`37bde5e9a`, which contains merged parent PR #2460 and commit `3dd8e3438`) into `issue/2502-contour-band-split` at `2c9fd0a0a`. The branch now includes `contour_whole_slice::next_region` and the middle-band check in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs`. It keeps the split between `contour.rs` (396 lines) and `contour_region.rs` (132 lines).
- **Pinning test:** `middle_step_without_a_flat_level_gets_its_floor_pass` in `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs`.
- **Mutation check:** Reverting `next_region` to `whole_region_at` in `contour_whole.rs` made `middle_step_without_a_flat_level_gets_its_floor_pass` fail with `expected one lap around the middle step at Z 10, got 0.000`. Restoring `contour_whole.rs` made the test pass.

### Verification on new head `2c9fd0a0a0a03333bb8e0b1f10c7c8ad7a88b08a`

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 116 of 118 steps passed. All 61 `camcraft-motion` steps passed, including `motion suites: lib` (434 passed, 10 ignored) and `motion suites: contour_whole` (8 passed).
- The 2 failed steps are pre-existing golden mismatches on `upstream/main` for T and H numbers in `app suites: thread_boss` (`an_external_m8_thread_verifies_clean_and_posts_helical_moves`) and `app suites: thread_mill` (`a_multi_form_mill_threads_m8_clean_and_posts_helical_moves`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_whole_step`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Please re-review PR #2537 at head `2c9fd0a0a0a03333bb8e0b1f10c7c8ad7a88b08a`.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This safety-tier review is clean. The earlier middle-step finding is resolved on this head.

What passed:

- All 10 moved or retained function bodies are byte-identical to upstream main. The public entry paths remain available.
- The split files contain 396 and 132 lines. Existing tests remain unchanged.
- The parent fix includes `next_region` and `middle_step_without_a_flat_level_gets_its_floor_pass`. The test passes.

- The decision record states the choice, the reason, and the alternatives that were dropped.

Local build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| Full `camcraft-motion` suite | 1,174 passed, 57 ignored, 0 failed |

| App `real_tip_contour` on the refreshed trial merge | 4 passed |
| `thread_boss::an_external_m8_thread_verifies_clean_and_posts_helical_moves` | Passed |

The full motion run used the first trial merge with main `7491ce4d6bc2aad599105420dd6ecc6b7a960def`.
Main then advanced to `9d6b57c0983afadabc452cd3ede452bb39cea577`. That update changed no motion source, app source, or review laws.
I refreshed the trial merge and repeated all 15 contour integration tests. Clippy and both thread tests also ran on the refreshed tree.

The two thread tests failed in the earlier review because main had stale NC goldens.
The main update fixes those goldens. I checked each changed line: only tool comments, T numbers, and H numbers change.
Both exact tests now pass. Those golden changes belong to main, not this PR.

I repeated the mutations locally:

| Mutation | Result with mutation | Result after restore |
|---|---|---|
| Replace `next_region` with `whole_region_at` | The middle-step test failed: `expected one lap around the middle step at Z 10, got 0.000` | Passed |
| Remove `check_unread` | The vertical-sliver test failed its diagnostic assertion; slicing reported Z12.199003 instead of the required Z11 diagnostic | Passed |
| Restore the old 514-line or 473-line layout in the external structural check | Both layouts failed the 400-line check | The 396-line and 132-line files passed |

Runtime mutations used an isolated source copy under the worktree's ignored `target/` directory. The copied source was restored.

Requested before merge: none.

Approved in the merge batch of 2026-11-18, but not merged in it: the head `2c9fd0a0a` conflicts with main in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs` (by hand, per `cargo xtask merge-plan`). It takes one merge of main with the conflict resolved by hand, then a read-only delta review of that merge (safety tier), then it merges. Label `merge-ready` swapped for `conflicts` until then.

I returned PR #2537 to draft to push the merge with `upstream/main`.

### 1. Resolve conflict with `main` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs`

- **What changed:** I merged `upstream/main` (`7cab31eea`) into `issue/2502-contour-band-split` at commit `021870109cdb478ef2adc8c417ad670bef09819a`. In `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs`, I kept `super::arcs::push_segs`, `super::tab_bridge::{cached, fit_tabs, keep_cut}`, and the `keep_cut` call from `main`. I also kept `super::contour_depth::Ladder` and the `contour_region` re-exports from this PR. `contour.rs` now has 388 lines, and `contour_region.rs` has 132 lines.
- **Pinning tests:** `contour_tab_bridge` (6 passed), `contour_tabs` (5 passed), `contour_whole` (8 passed), `contour_start` (21 passed), and `contour_whole_step` (3 passed).
- **Mutation check:** Changing `picked.is_some()` to `false` in `fit_tabs` made `a_picked_start_with_tabs_without_leads_keeps_the_tab` and `a_picked_start_with_tabs_enters_every_level_at_its_projection` in `crates/motion/tests/contour_start.rs` fail. Restoring `picked.is_some()` made all 21 tests in `contour_start` pass.

### Verification on new head `021870109cdb478ef2adc8c417ad670bef09819a`

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 120 steps passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_whole_step`: 3 passed, 0 failed.

Please run a delta re-review on PR #2537 at head `021870109cdb478ef2adc8c417ad670bef09819a`.
